sources_note: Official names, descriptions and grades as published by PlayStation and listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles; hidden flags as flagged by GTABase. Every guide below is written in my own words; sources are cited beside each guide.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: This is the platinum: it pops on its own the moment the other 54 trophies are done. Nothing here is online and no DLC is needed, so a single playthrough is enough. PowerPyx puts the whole run at roughly 200 hours on a 4/10 difficulty, and most of that time goes into the 100% completion checklist for A Long Road, so treat the platinum as a by-product of finishing everything else rather than a trophy you chase directly.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Pure story: finish Gone Fishing, the first main mission of Chapter 1, and this unlocks by itself. There is nothing to prepare and nothing that can go wrong — just play the opening mission through to its end.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 1 to its end. The trophy is awarded as Chapter 2 opens, right after the first mission of the new chapter, What's in the Bag? — so if it has not popped the instant the Chapter 1 finale ends, keep playing one mission into Chapter 2 and it will appear.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Like the other chapter trophies it is awarded as the next chapter begins — here, after Welcome to Vice City, the first mission of Chapter 3. Just keep playing the story and it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. This one arrives after the first two missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life, so do not worry if it is late — it is still automatic and unmissable as long as you keep playing the story.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4, which ends with the mission Starting From Zero. This is the last chapter trophy, so once it pops you are into the final stretch of the story.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the story's final mission. There is no mission replay and no choice of ending that changes this trophy — completing the last mission is all it asks. After the credits the game drops you back into free roam, so everything else on this list can still be cleaned up afterwards.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: A story mission trophy: complete Breakfast Run, a Chapter 2 main mission. It unlocks during the mission itself, so there is nothing extra to do and no way to miss it.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist, a Chapter 3 main mission. This is a story trophy that pops as you play through the mission — no side objective or special approach is required.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete Child's Play, a Chapter 4 main mission. Another automatic story trophy — finish the mission and it is yours.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete Headliners, a Chapter 4 main mission. It unlocks as part of the story with no extra condition, so just play the mission through.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete VCIA Takedown, a Chapter 4 main mission. A straightforward story trophy that pops when the mission is done.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete Operation Savage Glory, a Chapter 5 main mission. This is the last of the mission-name story trophies — finish it and only the finale stands between you and the gold for the final mission.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the set, and the one the whole platinum revolves around. The 100% checklist appears after the story under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion — but anything you already did during the story counts toward it, and nothing on it can be missed. It is far more forgiving than it sounds: the list is closer to 60% true completion. A few lines must be finished in full — every robbery, all 8 bank vaults, all 39 gang operations, the underwater discoveries, every shooting range gold medal, all drone races and all 15 of Bret's Target Decks. The rest only ask for a share: any 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 vehicle scans, 100 of 255 animal studies, 15 of 18 meditations, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts and 100 WAiNK scans. Work the checklist line by line after the story and this gold lands on its own.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off any 250 of the 397 stunts in the game, mixing the four types however you like: 130 stunt jumps off ramps, 202 flights under bridges, 40 knife flights between buildings and 25 base jumps with a parachute. Flying under bridges is the quickest way to pile them up. You only need to perform each stunt once — the optional challenge shown on a stunt's map icon is not required. Track your total under Progress, then Activities, then Stunts, and keep going to 300, because that is what the 100% checklist wants.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types at least once: fishing, hunting, golf, a shooting range, pool, basketball (sink one basket), playing an arcade game, winning a race of any kind, and performing a stunt. The story introduces you to most of them on its own, and the rest show up as blue dumbbell icons when you unfog the map. You can check what is left under Progress, then Activities. In practice this pops by itself while you work on the other trophies, so do not chase it first.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every shooting range challenge — 42 golds spread across 12 ranges. Every gold here is also required for the 100% checklist, so there is no way around doing them all. The ranges double as training: they raise your Focus level, which makes Gunslinger much easier later, so work on this silver before you try for the five-kill Combat Focus.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win one Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations. One win per spot is all this trophy asks, but do every race at a location while you are there: the 100% checklist wants all 42 drone races, so finishing them now saves a second trip later.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races out of the 40 on offer. Winning the same race twice does not count, so keep moving to new race locations instead of farming your favourite one. Drone race wins count toward your racing activity here too, so the races you do for Top Fun already help this total.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Meet Cal first: he shows up in the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui. Some time after that he sends a text that marks a fishing spot with a purple icon on the map, west of Key Lento. Follow his fishing quests to that spot and beat him in his fishing challenge. The quest stays available after the story, so there is no rush if the text arrives while you are busy elsewhere.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish any one of the four arcade games — called Video Games in-game. Three of them, Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind, are playable on the TV at home by interacting with the controllers, and you can already try them in Chapter 1. The fourth, Bang For Your Buck, sits on arcade machines around the world. To complete a game you only have to reach its end once; you do not need to beat every challenge inside it. Pick whichever game you enjoy most.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's questline is Lucia-only and gets marked on its own in Chapter 3: while playing as Lucia you get a call from Andy, then a text with her home address in Belville. Work through her five quests in order — Climbing the Cellerichain (in three parts), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label, and finally Puff Puff Pass. The trophy pops on that last one, and the whole line stays available after the story.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's line starts in Chapter 1, a while after the mission Island Dreams: he calls, then shows up as a green KR icon in Key Lento. He sends you diving for treasure at 7 shipwrecks — he marks each one with a purple chest icon, and you use the metal detector to dig the treasure out of the ocean floor, then bring it back to him. After the first set he calls you back for more. Do not panic when he goes quiet after Chapter 1: he becomes available again in Chapter 2 or 3 and texts Jason, and calling Brian as Jason later in Chapter 2 speeds that up. Track it under Progress, then Characters, then Kenton Rees, or under Collections, then Kenton's Treasures.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's line opens automatically after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, marked at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Do his five jobs in order — Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler (stealing the Impaler), and Hometown Heroes. The trophy pops on the last one, and all five stay available after the story.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 qualifying stranger mission strands found in the open world. The catch is that only certain questlines count: Kirk (the Skunk Ape hunts), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (the street-racing mentor line) and Pilot Pete (the delivery runs) are confirmed to count, while the lines of Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not, even though they look like strangers too. More qualifying strands are still being confirmed by the community, so check the trophy's own progress counter in your trophy list as you go. None of these are needed for 100% completion and all of them stay available in free roam after the story, so save this silver for the cleanup stage.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's wish list opens after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso for him and unlock the Key Cloner — that first car is already delivered as part of the mission. He then wants 16 more sports cars, tracked under Map, then Robberies, then Randy's Wish List, and delivered to his garage in west Vice City (green RK icon). Scan high-end cars with the WAiNK app to see whether one is on his list, or follow the cars he marks for you in fixed spots; hotel driveways around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach are good hunting grounds, and he marks new spots as you complete the ones he gave you. Delivering a car in good condition pays more, and the line stays open after the story.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's line is Jason-only and opens after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty. Purple markers point you to synthetic labs around Vice City: go there and destroy them as part of the quest Take Out Kitty Litter. Once you have taken out enough labs, Tyrone hands you his last job, Spin On This (shutting the labs down for good), and the trophy pops when that is done. Everything here stays available after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 All Meditation Spot Locations

trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot until the counter reaches 18. There are 18 meditations across 10 spot locations, and meditating at a spot with Jason and Lucia together counts twice, so most spots are worth two. Track it under Progress, then Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations, or filter the map for them. The last spot only opens after you have done the others, and it needs both characters, which is possible after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. THIS IS THE ONE POTENTIALLY MISSABLE TROPHY: in Chapter 1, the morning after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen at Jason's house — she says she is going to meditate, walks to the balcony, and if you follow her and choose Accept she teaches you to meditate. That moment is gone after Chapter 1. It is still unconfirmed whether this first meditation is actually required for the trophy, because it is not marked as a spot like the others, but it does raise the counter by one — so do it anyway, and make a manual save first. For the 100% checklist only 15 of 18 meditations are needed, so the checklist itself is safe either way.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret Vogel's hunting line is Jason-only and starts after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when Bret texts Jason and marks the first quest, Veteran Hunted, in Lummox County. After that he marks hunting spots with purple icons: hunt the animals he asks for and bring them back to him as Jason. On his first quest he gives you a unique hunting rifle, the Killtelligence SM-69, which you can pick up from any weapon locker at Ammu-Nation. A clean one-shot kill leaves the animal pristine and pays more, but it is not required. Track his requests under Map, then Activities, then Target Deck — there are 15 Target Decks in total, and all 15 are needed for the 100% checklist anyway. Fair warning from both guides: which exact animal triggers this trophy is still unconfirmed, so work through Bret's decks and it should come along the way.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 collectible card sets — you do not need all 18 sets in the game. Cards are scattered across Leonida as a collectible type, and the Collections section of the Progress menu shows how close each set is to completion. Pick the three sets you have already found the most cards for and finish those first; the rest can wait, because no other trophy asks for more than these three.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK spots with the phone's WAiNK app: hold Up on the D-pad, then R1, and point at a scannable object. Any 100 count — there are more than enough, split across 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures and the No Flusher tags. The 100% checklist also wants 100 WAiNK scans, so this silver and that checklist line finish together. Just scan anything the app highlights as you travel and the total climbs without any special route.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges. You can view them under Progress, then Challenges, where finished ones get a tick. Most of them complete themselves while you play — stunts, races, robberies and collectibles all feed into challenges — so leave this one alone until late: by the time the 100% checklist asks for 70 of 80, this trophy will already have popped. For the last few, pick the easiest ones left on your list and skip the hardest ten.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: You can only do this once Jason and Lucia can free-roam together, after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. Call your partner over by holding Right on the D-pad and pressing Triangle, then cause enough chaos to reach a 4-star wanted level and escape the red heat zone — the trophy counts when you are out of the heat, not just out of the flashing search area. A fast sports bike helps you cut through traffic, and the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County is a good escape route because the cops struggle to follow on the tracks and the helicopter cannot see you there. If you do not get it by hand, it will probably come on its own: the Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is opens the bank vault robberies, and those always bring 4 stars.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner alongside (call them with hold Right plus Triangle, after Coffee Break in Chapter 2), rob 3 shops in a row while staying wanted the whole time — the flashing red and blue wanted level, not the red heat level. Go in with body armor, sticky bombs and healing items, and loot properly in each shop: grab a couple of items, and ideally get into the back room and crack the safe with sticky bombs. The trophy pops about half a minute after you leave the third shop, so wait before deciding it failed — and if it still has not popped, hit a fourth shop and keep going. A good spot is the three jewelry stores in north Vice City, which open after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3. If you leave the first store before the police even arrive, the chain may not count, so let the wanted level build first.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. The easiest way is the WAiNK app: hold Up to open it instantly, look at a vehicle and hold R1 to scan it — scanning is enough, you never have to drive it. Stand on a busy road and scan everything that passes; with 557 vehicles in the game at launch you will hit 100 quickly. Check your totals under the touchpad menu, then Progress, then Vehicles. Keep scanning to 200 base models, because that is what the 100% checklist requires.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies inside a single use of Combat Focus. Activate it with L3 plus R3 while aiming a firearm: time slows and vulnerable spots on enemies light up, but it drains the purple focus bar fast, so preparation matters. Fill your focus first by eating, drinking, or washing your face and showering at home, and carry Adrenaline to stretch the slow time (hold L1, then press Triangle). Line up five enemies before you trigger it — the thugs at gang operations are ideal — and use an accurate full-auto weapon like the Duke 556 assault rifle. Note that police, soldiers and civilians do not seem to count, so pick a gang fight. Your focus level grows as you play shooting ranges, golf, pool and fishing, and by the time you reach focus level 4 this gets much easier, so try it late rather than early.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal one of the big passenger planes docked at a departure terminal at VCIA, the airport — it has to be a plane connected to a boarding bridge, not one parked out on the airfield. The easiest are the planes at departure terminals E3 and E4: drive through a fence around the airfield and head straight for the plane, where stairs next to the boarding bridge lead through a door directly inside. Go upstairs, get into the cockpit, drive the plane backwards to the runway, take off and fly about 1 kilometre away from the airport — the trophy is slightly delayed, so keep flying until it pops. You can also walk in through the terminal on foot, but the airfield route is faster.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank — a Rhino — from Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. The tanks stand at the south end of the air base: drive in through the gate, or use the stunt jump next to the south-east entrance. Climb in and shoot at enemies until the trophy pops. Expect heavy resistance on the way in, so go in with armor and a plan to get out fast once you have the tank.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: First finish Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 — that unlocks the Snap Gun, which silently lockpicks alarmed doors, and it also unlocks jewelry store robberies, marked with a green icon on unfogged parts of the map. Break into a store through its back door using the Snap Gun: kicking the door in sets off the alarm, so use the gadget prompt instead (it stays in your inventory permanently, no need to equip it). Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, loot the safe, and be sure to destroy the security footage and disable the alarm while you are there. The trophy unlocks shortly after you leave the store. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good spot to try first.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Bank vaults open with the optional Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is…: it gets marked on its own from story progress, and you do the first vault as part of it. The pattern is to tail a security van until it stops at a bank, then slip in while a guard carries a briefcase of cash inside and the vault is open. The haul is too heavy for one person, so bring your partner and hold Right on the D-pad to hand off a bag. After that mission, pay Yasmani $10,000 for tips about security vans — he is the fence unlocked in Chapter 3, and you may need to do his earlier quests first, including robbing two Payday Loans. Every vault robbery instantly gives a 4-star wanted level, so escape on a fast motorcycle and switch vehicles to become unrecognisable. There are 8 large bank jobs in total: any 5 earn this silver, but the 100% checklist needs all 8, and each one pays up to $205,000, so this is also the best money-maker in the endgame.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: The easiest path is the bank vault route: robbing a bank vault in That's Where The Money Is… counts as robbing an armored truck, because you tail the truck to the bank first, and escaping the red heat zone (or reaching a Pay 'n' Spray) finishes it — and since all 8 vaults are needed for 100% completion, this trophy comes free along the way. If you want it earlier, armored trucks also drive around Vice City near banks: block one's path, plant a sticky bomb on its back doors and blow them open, then escape the heat radius. You can find sticky bombs in the back of Yasmani's shop once you have done his quests.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Fully unfog the whole map of Leonida. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every dark, fogged patch until the entire map is visible. You will naturally clear most of it during the story and the collectible hunts, so save a dedicated sweep for the cleanup stage and mop up whatever black patches are left in one flight.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 gang operations in total, marked with yellow icons on the map when you get near them, and many are marked automatically from story progress. Keep count under Progress, then Gangs — scrolling over a gang shows how many of its operations you have robbed. This trophy only needs one per gang, but the 100% checklist needs all 39, so you will earn it automatically on the way to finishing them all.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach and order an Apple Martini, then drink it while standing next to the bar with the view in front of you. It is a small, quiet moment rather than a mission — a good palate cleanser between the bigger heists. GTABase notes the exact steps were still unconfirmed when they published, while PowerPyx names the bar and the drink, so follow the PowerPyx version and the trophy should pop as you drink.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal one specific car from one specific showroom and drive it straight through the window: the blue Banshee in the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City. You can only take it once you have the Key Cloner, unlocked in the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs — hack into the car, then drive forward through the glass. The trophy is slightly delayed and pops after you drive further away down the street, and it only unlocks from this blue Banshee, not from any other car. It is a deliberate nod to the Banshee from GTA III.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: This one is earned by stealing all three key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, one of the gang operations. It is first marked during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling. Buy sticky bombs from an Ammu-Nation first — you need them to blow the safe. Inside, take the luxury watch from the office in the south-east, the unique shotgun variant Gutterball Moreland 850 from the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway. The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you pick up the third item, and killing the enemies inside is not required. If you miss an item during the mission, do not worry: you do not need all three in one visit, and you can come back once the robbery icon respawns — though it takes a long time to come back, so grab everything you can on the first run.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum Strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. You can check the level under the touchpad menu, then Jason & Lucia, then Strength (the heart icon). You can only start this after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between the two characters. Raise Strength by working out — buy a membership at a fitness club, which you can filter for on the map under Activities — and always bring your partner along (hold Right and press Triangle to call them): while you actively train with one character, the other completes their training automatically, so you make double progress. After the story you can also work out at home.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile. You can watch the count by opening the trophy itself in the trophy list, and it helps to turn on Criminal Profile notifications in the settings (Settings, then UI, then HUD Notifications, then Criminal Profile on) — every time you do something that shifts your reputation, a little demon face appears on the right of the screen. The profiles run from Professional (clean, stealthy jobs) through Hardened and Violent to Psycho, and finally Irredeemable, which is permanent — steer clear of that last one, because the police become far more aggressive. Every robbery and enemy encounter counts, so this almost certainly pops on its own while you work on the other trophies. If it is still short at the end, you can farm the last few by running over civilians and police with a car — just know that at Psycho or Irredeemable the cops shoot on sight.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — be honest about this one. As of the guides published on 19 November 2026, nobody has pinned down how this trophy unlocks. The description, Second time's the charm, suggests succeeding at something on a second attempt. PowerPyx believes it is related to the Payday Loans store from the prologue in Little Cuba, possibly robbing it again later in a specific way, but that is a guess, not a verified method. Do not waste time farming guesses: keep playing, revisit the Payday Loans store in Little Cuba later in the game and try robbing it again, and check the community guides for an update — this entry will be corrected as soon as a method is confirmed.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: This is the UFO easter egg. Go to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County, at night after 2AM, and go alone. Sometimes a blinking car is parked at the roadside — if it is not there, drive away and come back until it shows up, because the event is slightly random and not guaranteed. Next to the blinking car, follow the path into the woods and you will see the UFO, a bright blue light in the sky. Approach it and the UFO drops a woman it abducted: talk to her, offer to help, and she asks you to go back to her car at the roadside. Do that and the trophy unlocks. GTABase lists this one as still unconfirmed, while PowerPyx gives the full sequence above, so treat the PowerPyx steps as the best current method.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Ride any bike and kick 10 pedestrians with Square within 60 seconds. Do it somewhere crowded, like the streets of Vice City or along Ocean Beach, where pedestrians are packed together and you can chain the kicks without losing speed. GTABase notes the exact steps were still unconfirmed when they published, while PowerPyx names the bike-kick method above, so that is the method to try first — if it does not pop, slow down and make sure each kick actually connects before moving to the next pedestrian.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew): that unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer you need to launder marked bills. Then rob banks and Payday Loans stores and bring the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The $250,000 is a running total across all your robberies, not a single delivery, so it builds up naturally while you do the robberies the 100% checklist demands anyway. Bank vaults are the big earner here: a single vault can pay up to $205,000, though vaults only open after the Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is….

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 across all types of shops — it is a running total, so every purchase counts. The fastest way to burn through it is the expensive stuff: guns at Ammu-Nation, car mods, and tattoos. By the time you have bought the garages for Little Boxes, the weapons and upgrades for the heists and the registrations for On the Spot, you will be most of the way there without even trying.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages, which cost about $160,000 in total. They become available after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver (stealing the Crawler for Moses), when you get a notification that the Vice City Real Estate app has been installed on your phone — buy the garages through that app. The 4 garages the story gives you do not count, only the 8 for sale. Robberies are the quickest way to earn the money, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3 and 4, and the garages also give you the parking space you need to register vehicles for On the Spot.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: The Scooter Bros app lands on your phone after the Chapter 2 mission with Moses (taking a vehicle to him). It lets you register stolen vehicles and have them delivered to you wherever you are. To register 10 vehicles you need free garage space first — each garage adds one or more parking spots, so this trophy pairs with Little Boxes. Drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and, in his garage, choose Respray and then Register. At first he only accepts vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Each registration costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes to keep the bill down.

roadmap.title: Stage 1 — Play the story (about 60–80 hours)
roadmap.text: Finish the five chapters and take the side content as it appears. Do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation for Positive Mental Attitude before Chapter 1 ends — it is the only potentially missable trophy. Start the questlines of Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret as they open, scan vehicles with the WAiNK app and study animals with binoculars as you go, and keep a manual save at the start and end of each chapter (15 manual slots, no mission replay).

roadmap.title: Stage 2 — 100% completion checklist (about 100 hours)
roadmap.text: After the credits, open Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion and work the list line by line: every robbery, all 8 bank vaults, all 39 gang operations, underwater discoveries, shooting range golds, drone races, Bret's 15 Target Decks, any 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 vehicle scans, 100 of 255 animal studies, 15 of 18 meditations, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts and 100 WAiNK scans. Most trophies in this stage pop while you clear the checklist.

roadmap.title: Stage 3 — Strangers & Freaks and cleanup (about 10–20 hours)
roadmap.text: Finish the 8 qualifying stranger strands, then sweep up whatever is left: the partner trophies (Hot Together, Retail Therapy), the stunt and easter-egg trophies (Gunslinger, Catch Me If You Can, Challenging Tank, Ten Pin, The Truth Is Out There, Bad Luck I Guess) and the quiet ones (In The Beginning…, Capital Offense, Let's Go Bowling). The platinum pops when the last of these does.
